methods_quotes.q: Each case was assigned a sample weight based on the inverse probability of selection
A direct variance estimation procedure was used to calculate 95% confidence intervals (CIs) and to account for the complex sample design.
Population estimates for 2001--2003 were obtained from the U.S. Census Bureau to compute injury rates.
